legal_basis.regulation: MIIT Notice on Improving Users' Experience of Information and Communications Services

legal_basis.regulation: Information Security Technology: Basic Requirements for Personal Information Collection by Mobile Internet Applications

verdict_hints: Collection purpose, method, category, use, or retention period is unspecified
Sensitive information is not highlighted

rules.name: Collection or use of personal information without consent

checkpoint.objective: Observe consent controls, actual denial outcomes, and inducement wording; record any related consent issue.

Forced bundled authorization
Induced consent
Relevant processing continues after denial

checkpoint.objective: Compare registration, login, and profile forms against the actual business category; one relevant unnecessary collection item is sufficient for a finding.
verdict_hints: Mandatory information unrelated to the functionality
Collection exceeds the category's necessary scope
Unnecessary information requested all at once
Apply the necessary scope for the actual app category, not requirements from unrelated industries.

rules.name: Missing separate consent or guardian consent
rules.clause: Missing separate consent or guardian consent

legal_basis.regulation: Personal Information Protection Law of the People's Republic of China
legal_basis.clause: Articles 29 and 31: sensitive information and minors' information require separate consent or guardian consent

legal_basis.clause: Separately disclose sensitive-information collection and obtain explicit consent

legal_basis.regulation: Information Security Technology: Basic Requirements for Personal Information Collection by Mobile Internet Applications
legal_basis.clause: Obtain separate explicit consent for collecting sensitive personal information

checkpoint.objective: Exercise actual sensitive-data or minors-related functionality and inspect confirmation steps; identify the branch observed.
verdict_hints: Sensitive-information processing lacks separate notice or confirmation
Applicable processing of minors' information lacks guardian consent

legal_basis.clause: Assessment items 28-29: do not repeatedly request denied permissions or change permissions after an update

legal_basis.regulation: Methods for Identifying Illegal Collection and Use of Personal Information by Apps
legal_basis.clause: IV-1 to IV-6: breaches of necessity, including unrelated data, bundled authorization, or excessive request frequency

legal_basis.regulation: Information Security Technology: Personal Information Security Specification
legal_basis.clause: Minimize personal-information collection according to necessity

checkpoint.objective: Trigger and deny permissions, then continue relevant actions; observe repeated, bundled, or unnecessary requests.
verdict_hints: Repeated requests after denial
Bundled requests for unrelated permissions
Permission scope or timing does not match the current functionality

Unreasonable account-deletion conditions
Request workflow is obstructed

Customer-service telephone not disclosed
Response deadline unspecified

legal_basis.regulation: Self-Assessment Guide for Illegal Collection and Use of Personal Information by Apps
legal_basis.clause: Assessment item 19: privacy policies must not contain unreasonable exclusions or terms

checkpoint.objective: Read policy provisions on responsibilities, rights, and authorization; cite specific terms as evidence.
verdict_hints: Unreasonable liability exclusions, restrictions on user rights, or expanded authorization

legal_basis.regulation: MIIT Notice on Improving Users' Experience of Information and Communications Services
legal_basis.clause: Improve launch/pop-up presentation: provide a visible close button and avoid deceptive full-screen image/video links

legal_basis.regulation: MIIT Notice on Further Improving Mobile Internet Application Service Capabilities
legal_basis.clause: Launch screens and pop-ups need clear close buttons without repeated interference or misleading taps

checkpoint.objective: Observe and actually try closing launch screens, pop-ups, and ads; record obstacles.
verdict_hints: Close button absent, inconspicuous, or ineffective
Unreasonable barriers to closing

legal_basis.regulation: MIIT Notice on Improving Users' Experience of Information and Communications Services
legal_basis.clause: Improve launch/pop-up presentation: provide a visible close button and avoid deceptive full-screen image/video links

legal_basis.regulation: MIIT Notice on Further Improving Mobile Internet Application Service Capabilities
legal_basis.clause: Launch screens and pop-ups need clear close buttons without repeated interference or misleading taps

checkpoint.objective: Record repeated pop-ups, misleading wording, clickable regions, and actual destinations; record any related behavior.
verdict_hints: Repeated pop-ups interfere with use
Full-screen misleading click target
Closing triggers an unrelated redirect or download

legal_basis.regulation: MIIT Notice on Further Improving Mobile Internet Application Service Capabilities
legal_basis.clause: Automatic subscriptions/renewals require notice and must not be preselected

checkpoint.objective: Inspect membership, renewal notices, and cancellation instructions without paying, subscribing, or canceling an existing subscription.
verdict_hints: Automatic renewal preselected
Unclear renewal notice
Cancellation method hard to find or unreachable

legal_basis.regulation: MIIT Notice on Further Improving Mobile Internet Application Service Capabilities
legal_basis.clause: Prominently disclose fees and additional conditions; do not silently add restrictions

checkpoint.objective: Inspect actual service/payment pages for fees and conditions without paying.
verdict_hints: Missing or unclear price, period, additional conditions, or service restrictions

legal_basis.regulation: MIIT Notice on Further Improving Mobile Internet Application Service Capabilities
legal_basis.clause: Provide permission-use records and a notification mechanism

checkpoint.objective: Inspect permission settings, records, and usage notices; state which entrypoints and functionalities were checked.
verdict_hints: Permission use lacks accessible records or necessary notices

legal_basis.regulation: MIIT Notice on Further Improving Mobile Internet Application Service Capabilities
legal_basis.clause: Allow users to disable self-start/associated start and reset device identifiers

checkpoint.objective: Inspect related settings and startup behavior when runtime records exist. A missing switch is a related issue but does not prove frequent startup was observed.
verdict_hints: Abnormal or frequent startup observed
No way to disable self-start or associated start

legal_basis.regulation: MIIT Notice on Further Improving Mobile Internet Application Service Capabilities
legal_basis.clause: Allow users to disable self-start/associated start and reset device identifiers

checkpoint.objective: Locate reset methods in device-ID, advertising-ID, and privacy settings; record related issues.
verdict_hints: Device/advertising identifier reset entrypoint absent, unreachable, or ineffective
